seed.title: Add more supported fanfic sites
seed.summary: Support MediaMiner.org, ScribbleHub, Literotica, SpiritFanfiction, AlternateHistory, fimfiction.net, tthfanfic.org, and FanficParadise forums.

seed.title: Reliable story updates & cache refresh
seed.summary: Files don't refresh when a fic is updated without new chapters; provide a way to invalidate cache for a story and auto-check for updates.

seed.title: More export formats: Markdown, text, ODT, DOCX
seed.summary: Add Markdown, plain text, ODT and DOCX export options in addition to EPUB/PDF/MOBI/HTML.

seed.title: Fix HTML export formatting bugs
seed.summary: HTML exports mangle dashes (em/en -> hyphen), drop chapter titles, lose underline/formatting, and include garbage tags.

seed.title: Improve EPUB quality
seed.summary: Fix random spaces, support book-style paragraph indentation, and preserve chapter ordering when chapters are inserted out of sequence.

seed.title: Fix download failures & blank exports
seed.summary: Address blank downloads, PDF export failures on fanfiction.net, 503 errors, and 'response was not valid' conversion errors.

seed.title: Enable CORS on API for userscripts
seed.summary: Return Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * on API endpoints so bookmarklets and userscripts can call FicHub directly.

seed.title: Expose cover images via API
seed.summary: Add cover image support to the API for frontends and third-party apps.

seed.title: Download entire series (AO3)
seed.summary: Support downloading a whole AO3 series, not just individual works.

seed.title: Bulk mirroring / database import
seed.summary: Allow bulk mirroring of databases and batch submission of stories FicHub has trouble with.

seed.title: Wayback Machine fallback
seed.summary: Use Wayback Machine to fetch stories from already-supported sites when the live site blocks or fails.

seed.title: XenForo threadmark support
seed.summary: Handle Apocrypha, Side Story, and Informational threadmarks on SpaceBattles/Sufficient Velocity and XenForo forums.

seed.title: Book description & metadata improvements
seed.summary: Include story descriptions in exports and fix wrong author associations.

seed.title: Contributing guide & docs
seed.summary: Explain how to contribute to the project and document setup requirements.

seed.title: Cosmetic fixes
seed.summary: Fix timezone display and chapter numbering issues.
